notes: 3 fresh read-only Checkers on base..head (Maker != Checker). All three verdicts clean with zero findings — a substantial behavioral change (2D/3D mode) shipped clean. Verified: (1) the resyncModule funnel is behaviour-preserving in the 3D default (moduleSuggestion in 3D = suggestModule(ceiling,opening), so routing the room reducers through it recomputes the same height-derived value — a no-op; existing withCeiling/withOpening tests stay green, 89/89), and mode-aware in 2D (untouched module tracks room edits — FR-MODE-02); (2) FR-MODE-04 shared-state preservation holds — withMode only flips mode + resyncs, rooms/heights preserved, a TOUCHED (selected) module is sticky, an UNTOUCHED one re-derives (spec.md scenario documents this — an untouched module 'followed the suggestion', was never selected); (3) BC-PRIVACY-01/FR-MODE-05 — mode lives only in Calculator useState, repo-wide grep finds no localStorage/sessionStorage/cookie/indexedDB/network sink; (4) mode-aware isApartmentValid (2D ignores hidden heights) is additive and necessary for 2D usability, does not overreach apartment-input's spec; (5) the band-diagram gate on mode==='3d' completes the documented deferral from vertical-bands (change 8), in its correct home; (6) TC-ARCH-01 single-owner preserved — Calculator computes moduleSuggestion once (memoized), flows it down; (7) NFR-A11Y-03 role=group + two aria-pressed tabbable buttons is a legitimate pattern. Scope clean: no visualizer (viz-2d/viz-3d) code — 'active visualizer changes' deferred to 14/15; no new dependency; i18n +1 key (mode) with parity held (93/93). Runtime-verified by the Maker before review: 3D default renders height fields + band diagram + 'suggested from heights'; a reverted DEFAULT_STATE.mode='2d' flip rendered with those hidden + 'suggested from room dimensions' + 2D aria-pressed. strict PASS.
